hypothesis: Order, explicit separator association, or shared rune fragments may identify a tractable structural clue without recovering a key.
mechanistic_basis: Repeated-key/state reuse can leave local equality or shared-fragment structure; preserved word boundaries or boundary-dependent processing can associate symbols with explicit '-' positions. These observations do not uniquely identify those mechanisms.
applicable_objects: All 55 pages containing runes; 12956 rune indices in total

excluded_objects.reason: No rune-domain symbols; literal alphanumeric grid retained but not mapped to runes

representation: Only original rune indices 0..28; no Latin, GP primes, affine transforms, dictionary, plaintext scoring or key search
parameter_derivation_policy: Fixed lags 1..29 span one alphabet length as a bounded exploratory window, not a predicted key length. Fixed 4-rune windows provide exact local collision evidence. No page-specific tuning.

segmentation.soft: Literal - . , / and whitespace may occur within a rune-prose segment. Their tokens are retained and do not consume a rune ordinal.
segmentation.hard: All other non-rune characters, including & $ section marks, unresolved semicolon, quotes/apostrophes and digits, split a prose segment. No A/C pair or window crosses such a gap or page edge.
segmentation.boundary_mask: 1 iff a literal '-' occurs between the preceding rune and this rune within the same segment. Segment-first rune excluded from B. '/' and CR/LF alone do not set the mask.
segmentation.ambiguity: No glyph edits or unknown-literal deletion; exact token IDs and source offsets are retained. Input not independently glyph-verified across all pages.

page_and_section_continuity_hypothesis: No encryption clock assumed. A/C respect page and hard-segment boundaries. B independently rotates each segment on a circle solely to generate its null distribution; wrap seam is a null-model assumption, not a claim about encryption.

statistics.A: For every page and lag 1..29: count equal rune pairs at that ordinal lag with both endpoints in the same segment. 55*29=1595 columns.
statistics.B: Per page: G=2 sum O log(O/E) in rune-identity x literal-hyphen-mask 29x2 table, using eligible positions. Zero for degenerate table. 55 columns.
statistics.C: One corpus statistic: number of unordered matching 4-rune window pairs from different pages. Within-page multiplicity counts; a pair never compares a page to itself. Windows wholly within segments.
statistics.descriptive: Per-page length, symbol counts and IC; these do not have an acceptance gate or indicate plaintext by themselves.

controls.A_C_null: Independent uniform within-page permutations preserving each page's symbol counts and all fixed positional masks; A and C share each randomized corpus.
controls.B_null: Independent uniform cyclic rotation within each fixed prose segment; page masks fixed. Preserves cyclic local order and segment composition, with the explicit seam limitation.
controls.studentization: A/B columns centered/scaled by symmetric mean and population SD of observed + all 999 controls. Zero-SD columns marked nondiscriminating, never assigned infinite Z. Store all raw controls and standardization values.
controls.maxT: A/B each use the maximum standardized statistic across their whole family for every control row. Adjusted p=(1+number of control maxima >= observed Z-1e-12)/1000. C uses upper-tail raw count with the same plus-one formula.
controls.scope: Family-wide randomization tests under the stated joint exchangeability/rotation nulls. No strong error-control claim under arbitrary mixtures of page nulls and alternatives.

correlated_transform_deduplication: No transformed views run. A/B invariant under any separate page-wise bijective rune relabeling; C requires a common global bijection. Related A/C results count as one order/repetition evidence cluster, not two independent confirmations.
multiple_testing_policy: Three families Bonferroni across family tests, total alpha=.01. A/B already maxT-corrected internally. Formal structural lead if family-adjusted p<=.01/3 (resolution .001). This is not a decryption acceptance criterion.

total_budget.evaluations: 1000 corpora including observed for A/C, 1000 B rotation corpora; 1,595,000 A metrics, 55,000 B metrics, 1000 C metrics
total_budget.origin: Bounded diagnostic design for this authorized attempt; no inherited side-chat budget

discovery_path: Use all applicable pages; no held-out cipher symbols in this version. Retain every page and metric, not just winners.
independent_validation_path: Independent code recomputes raw measurements and corrected probabilities from saved controls; verifies exact source/token locations. This validates implementation/measurement only, not independent cryptanalytic confirmation.
drilldown_policy: After scan, inspect at most one strongest localization per family (three families maximum, retain ties in raw table). A: all matching pair locations at strongest page/lag. B: full 29x2 counts and masks at strongest page. C: most cross-page collision-rich 4-rune tuple, lexicographic tie break, all its occurrences, deterministic matching left/right extension within segments. Any new mechanistic test must receive a new frozen version; same-data follow-up labeled post-selection exploratory.
success: At least one family reaches the registered structural lead threshold and its arithmetic/source-location audit passes; no claim of key/plaintext recovery
failure: Complete controls and none passes: negative only for these three statistics and nulls. Insufficient or partial computation is inconclusive/timeout/error, never negative.
